in_hebrew.name: Amathist
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Love of the earth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amathist הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'amathos', meaning 'ground' or 'earth'. In Christian spirituality, Amathist can symbolize a deep connection to nature and the earth, as well as a reverence for the physical world as a manifestation of God's creation.
